0022600234.text: The Brooklyn Nets (3-8, 13th in the East and 6.5 games back in the Atlantic) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (7-4, 9th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Southwest) in the Nets' 12th game of the season. Brooklyn enters on a one-game winning streak, with a 3-7 record over its last ten and a 2-5 mark on the road, while Memphis has lost its last game but is 6-4 over its last ten and 2-4 at home. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with Brooklyn winning the most recent meeting 126-115 in Brooklyn on March 9, 2026, and they have no 2026-27 meetings yet; Brooklyn is without Mikel Brown Jr. (illness; 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes per game this season) and Nolan Traore (calf soreness), and Memphis is without Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness).
